title: Calculate exact Budget Positions
description: Compare one explicit Budget Plan Revision with current corrected public LEDGER Budget Actuals under one snapshot, without interpretation. Implements G4 and G7 through UC-BUDGET-003.
rationale: The owner and INSIGHTS need one reproducible raw answer for plan versus actual before any pace, forecast, or narrative is added.
story_want: an exact category and total plan-versus-actual position
story_so_that: every amount can be reconciled before decisions or analysis
acceptance_criteria: Given a Budget Period with one Active revision and no revision selector, when Get Budget Position is requested, then the result is bound to that Active revision and reports its Active lifecycle status.

Given an explicit readable Draft, Active, or Superseded revision identifier, when Get Budget Position is requested, then that revision is evaluated without activation or lifecycle mutation and its status is returned.

Given a period has no Active revision and no revision selector, when Get Budget Position is requested, then BUDGET returns the explicit No Active Budget Plan Revision state and does not fabricate a zero plan.

Given a selected plan and no matching LEDGER actuals, when the position is returned, then every planned value is preserved, actual totals are exact zero, and the state remains distinct from an empty or absent plan.
Given LEDGER actuals assigned to a category with a positive planned entry, when the position is calculated, then those actuals appear exactly once in that category budgeted position.
Given LEDGER actuals assigned to a category with a Zero Budget entry, when the position is calculated, then those actuals appear exactly once in that category Zero Budget Position.

Given LEDGER actuals assigned to a valid Spend Category omitted from the selected revision and no element of that Budget Actual's frozen Spend Category ancestry carries a Category Budget Entry, when the position is calculated, then those actuals appear exactly once as Unbudgeted Spend keyed by the exact assigned Spend Category identifier.

Given LEDGER actuals without a current Spend Category assignment, when the position is calculated, then those actuals appear exactly once as Uncategorized Spend and no category or planned amount is invented.

Given any selected plan and LEDGER snapshot, when category and total values are returned, then planned totals equal the exact sum of explicit entries and actual totals equal the exact sum of budgeted, Zero Budget, Unbudgeted Spend, and Uncategorized Spend actuals.
Given a planned category or total whose planned amount is at least its actual amount, when variance is returned, then Remaining equals planned minus actual and Over equals exact zero.
Given a planned category or total whose actual amount exceeds its planned amount, when variance is returned, then Over equals actual minus planned and Remaining equals exact zero.
Given a refund-heavy category or period produces a negative LEDGER Budget Actual, when the position is returned, then the negative value is preserved exactly and is not clamped or reclassified.

Given identical plan revision, LEDGER snapshot, period, category state, and categorization state, when the position is repeated, then categorized positions are ordered by stable category identifier ascending, the Uncategorized position follows them, and exact values, states, and provenance are semantically identical.

Given a successful position, when provenance is inspected, then it includes plan identity, revision identifier and status, period boundaries, currency, category-contract version, LEDGER contract version, snapshot identifier, and calculation schema version.

Given LEDGER corrections, allocation changes, relationship changes, voids, or supersessions after an earlier query, when a new position is requested, then current corrected actuals are recomputed under a new cited snapshot while the selected plan revision remains unchanged.
Given a position is returned, when its schema is inspected, then it contains no pace, forecast, trend, anomaly, recommendation, narrative, alert, or spending-control decision.
Given a position query completes, when durable BUDGET state is inspected, then no separate actual or report snapshot was persisted by BUDGET.

Given an Unbudgeted or Uncategorized position, when its values are returned, then Planned, Remaining, and Over are explicitly not applicable rather than zero, while its exact actual value remains present.

Given a valid period with no Budget Plan and no revision selector, when Get Budget Position is requested, then BUDGET returns the explicit No Budget Plan state and does not fabricate a plan, revision, or position.

Given a Category Budget Entry on a parent Spend Category and Budget Actuals assigned to that parent directly and to descendant Spend Categories one and two levels below that carry no entry, when the position is calculated, then every one of those Budget Actuals appears exactly once in the parent Budgeted position, and that row reports the direct subtotal, the descendant subtotal, and the absorbed descendant Spend Category identifiers in ascending ordinal order.

Given Category Budget Entries on both a parent Spend Category and one of its descendants, when the position is calculated, then a Budget Actual assigned at or below the descendant appears exactly once in the descendant position and is excluded from the parent position, while a Budget Actual under the parent outside the descendant subtree appears exactly once in the parent position.

Given a Category Budget Entry with Planned Spend equal to zero on a descendant Spend Category whose ancestor carries Planned Spend greater than zero, when the position is calculated, then Budget Actuals at or below that descendant appear exactly once in the descendant Zero Budget Position and no part of them falls back to the funded ancestor.

Given any selected revision and LEDGER snapshot, when every category position is returned, then each row's actual value equals the exact sum of its direct actual value and its descendant actual value, and the sum across all rows plus Uncategorized Spend equals the membership total, so no Budget Actual is counted more than once.

Given a Budget Plan Revision whose Spend Categories are all root nodes with no descendants, when the position is calculated, then every value, bucket, ordering, and total is identical to the `budget-position-v1` exact-identity result for the same inputs.

Given a successful position over a hierarchical Spend Category tree, when a Budget Actual member is inspected through the INSIGHTS read projection, then it reports its frozen Spend Category ancestry root-first with the assigned Spend Category last, and reports the effective Spend Category identifier that governed it, or null when the outcome is Unbudgeted Spend or Uncategorized Spend.

Given a Budget Actual member whose frozen Spend Category ancestry is empty for a categorized member, does not end with the assigned Spend Category identifier, repeats an identifier, or names an identifier absent from the known Spend Category evidence, when the position is calculated, then BUDGET returns the stable integrity failure and no partial totals.

Given Budget Actuals on two distinct Spend Categories whose shared ancestry carries no Category Budget Entry, when the position is calculated, then each produces its own Unbudgeted Spend row whose direct actual equals its row actual, whose descendant actual is exactly zero, and whose absorbed identifier list is empty, and no aggregated ancestor row is produced.
security_criteria: A position is owner-readable financial data and may be emitted only by the explicit structured data-return operation.
